<b>Magnetite Brooch</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Yellow|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It attracts loose [[Rosaries]].

== Usefulness ==
Magnetite Brooch pulls loose [[Rosaries]] dropped by [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] or from Rosary caches towards [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]. This can save time spent chasing down loose Rosaries, and reduces the risk of Rosaries being destroyed by rolling into hazards like spikes or lava. The effect does not stop Rosaries from falling directly into such hazards.

Rosaries that generate as loose on the ground are not affected by the Magnetite Brooch until Hornet swings her needle while near them.

{{Clear}}

==  How to acquire ==
Purchased from [[Pebb]] in [[Bone Bottom]] for {{R|120}}. If it was not purchased before the start of [[Act 3]], it can be purchased from [[Grindle]] in [[Blasted Steps]] for {{R|220}}.

== Trivia ==
* Magnetite is the name of a [[wikipedia:Magnetite|real-world mineral]] that is ferrimagnetic, meaning it is attracted to magnets and can become magnetic itself. Naturally-magnetic magnetite, traditionally called lodestone, was the source of the original discovery of magnetism.
